rules.name: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Details
rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be declared on every package.

rules.name: Common/Generic Name of Commodity
rules.description: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package must be clearly stated.

rules.name: Net Quantity
rules.description: Net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight (g/kg), volume (mL/L), or number/count.

rules.name: Month & Year of Manufacture/Import
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported.

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: Retail Sale Price (MRP Rs. X.XX inclusive of all taxes) must be prominently printed.

rules.name: Consumer Care Details
rules.description: Name, address, telephone number, and email ID of the person/office to contact in case of consumer complaints.

rules.name: Minimum Font Height Threshold
rules.description: Minimum height of declaration letters (1.0mm normal print, 2.0mm embossed/molded).

rules.name: Manner & Prominence of MRP
rules.description: MRP declaration must be visually prominent and larger than surrounding text.
